title: Email Marketing Tools Pricing Guide 2026: Mailchimp vs Klaviyo vs ActiveCampaign vs Kit

facts.fact: The page states that email marketing pricing scales with subscriber count, so costs that start at $20/month can reach $500–2,000/month as a list grows.
facts.quote: what starts at $20/month can hit $500–2,000/month as your list grows

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp raised prices 30% in 2022 and changed its free plan.
facts.quote: Mailchimp raised prices +30% in 2022 and changed their free plan.

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp restricted its free plan to 500 contacts, down from 2,000 previously.
facts.quote: restricted the free plan to 500 contacts — down from 2,000 previously.

facts.fact: The page says Mailchimp raised paid plan prices 30–45% in 2024.
The page lists Mailchimp's Essentials plan at $13/month for 1K contacts.
The page lists Mailchimp's Standard plan at $20/month for 1K contacts.
The page lists Mailchimp's Premium plan at $350+/month at every listed contact tier.
The page says Mailchimp's Mandrill add-on for transactional email starts at $20/month for 500K emails and is not included in any Mailchimp plan.
The page says Mailchimp counts a contact in two audiences as two contacts for billing.
facts.quote: A contact in 2 audiences counts as 2 contacts.

facts.fact: The page lists Klaviyo's free tier as 250 contacts at $0 for email only.
The page lists Klaviyo's email-only plan for 1,001–1,500 contacts at $30/month.
The page lists Klaviyo's email-only plan for 50,001–60,000 contacts at $700/month.
The page lists Klaviyo's plan for 100,001+ contacts as custom pricing starting at $1,500+.
The page states Klaviyo charges $0.01 per outbound SMS, plus carrier fees.
facts.quote: Klaviyo charges separately for SMS: $0.01/SMS for outbound

facts.fact: The page states Klaviyo counts all profiles, including unsubscribed and suppressed ones, toward the billing tier.
facts.quote: Klaviyo counts all profiles (subscribed, unsubscribed, suppressed) toward your billing tier.

facts.fact: The page says Klaviyo's Reviews add-on costs $25–$100+/month depending on orders.
The page lists ActiveCampaign's Starter plan at $15/month for 500 contacts.
The page lists ActiveCampaign's Plus plan at $49/month for 500 contacts.
The page lists ActiveCampaign's Professional plan at $79/month for 500 contacts.
The page's comparison table says ActiveCampaign has no free tier and offers a 14-day trial.
The page's comparison table lists Kit (ConvertKit) as free up to 10K subscribers, then $100/month at 10K subscribers.
The page's comparison table lists Beehiiv's free tier as 2,500 subscribers and its price at 10K subscribers as $42/month.
The page's comparison table lists Brevo's free tier as unlimited contacts with a 300-emails-per-day sending limit.
